name: table-3d-responsive-ui-upgrade
title: Upgrade table 3D modal on desktop and mobile
description: Refine the existing manager table 3D simulator into a clearer desktop workspace and a reliable single-column mobile workflow without changing business behavior.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Completed screenshot follow-up. Compact catalog cards now keep only short semantic badges, so raw license strings no longer cross card boundaries. The final modal repair CSS is loaded after later table workflow/mobile styles. A narrow content-safety layer centers the loading card, constrains badge/card overflow, and keeps the disabled placement hint inside its action cell on desktop and mobile. No backend, GraphQL, permission, audit, AR persistence or callback behavior changed. No CI status or workflow was available for the implementation commit; local component tests, production build, 390x844/430x932 checks and physical phone validation were not run through the GitHub connector.
